title: Electrochemically Mediated Carbon Capture on Surface-Confined Quinone: Unveiling Interfacial Pathways via Surface-Enhanced Spectroscopy

conditions.quote: Figure 2a presents the cyclic voltammograms of AQ-grafted gold electrodes in 0.1 M TBAPF6/MeCN under an inert atmosphere
Cyclic voltammetry conducted under CO2 introduction (Figure 2c) reveals a progressive transformation in the voltammetric response.

measurements.quote: The first wave, centered at E1/2 = −1.32 V vs. Fc/Fc+, corresponds to the one-electron reduction of neutral anthraquinone (NAQ) to the radical anion (RAQ)
the second one-electron reduction is attributed to the formation of the dianion species (DAQ), appears at E1/2 = −1.98 V vs Fc/Fc+

observations.quote: CO2 binding was observed only after the second electron transfer, resulting in the formation of a mono(carbonate) DAQ−CO2 complex.
